_evidence: 0x0052d6ed (and its wrappers 0x52da11..0x52db86) ORs the 8 dwords of the 256-bit key-state bitmap 0x8245a0..0x8245bf (run-time keyboard state, zero in the image) to test 'any key down'. Any pattern is a valid keyboard state; each dword is mostly 0 so the all-empty case (about 1 in 4) and non-empty cases both occur.
